The standard service level for processing Overflight/Technical landing authorization requests that are operated under a Standard Certificate of Airworthiness is between 1 to 5 days. There is no fee for this service.

entries.functionText:
For aircraft with seats for more than 30 PAX, CAA of China will require to obtain Charter permit ISO business permit. 
For charter permit, it will be very complicated. 

To perform this flight it will be required to have Charter Agreement. The charter agreement is the mutual agreement between CAA of China and operator CAA. 
Only if operator is listed on the agreement it can operate between operator’s country and CHINA. 
Pls kindly noted that an country A register aircraft can only operate sector Country A – China – Country A 
For single flight, it will take about 15working days if CAA of China will agree to process the permit.

entries.functionText:
Not later 7 working days!                                              OVF PERMIT VALIDITY:
Chinese CAA mainly pays attention to Beijing local time, not UTC time. 
Remains valid in case of 2-3 hours earlier departure. 
In regards of delay, permission will remain valid until the end of the day (Beijing time) and needs to be revalidated in case of further delay. 
Dates crossing needs to be validated in advance.                     If China OVF permit revision is sent 1 day before flight after 0400Z from Monday to Friday, weekends or on special holidays – there will be an extra coordination fee up to around USD 1000. 
With extra fee there will be a bigger chance to get the permit. 

CAAC urgent department will process the applications on operation day - in fact department will process applications after 0400Z from Monday to Friday, weekends or on special holidays.
entries.info:
For example, if the approved schedule is as below. 

SCHEDULE(UTC): 
18OCT17 RKSS 17:50 UUEE 02:30 (19OCT17) 
Beijing time is:19OCT17 RKSS 01:50 UUEE 10:30 (19OCT17) 

Since Beijing time is UTC+8, if make 3 hours earlier such as below, you had better to update the permit. 
SCHEDULE(UTC): 
18OCT17 RKSS 14:50 UUEE 23:30 (18OCT17) 
Beijing time is: 18OCT17 RKSS 22:50 UUEE 07:30 (19OCT17)
CAAC normal department operates 0100-0800Z Monday to Friday (except special holidays). 

If China OVF permit revision is submitted 1 working day before flight between 0100Z-0400Z - we can apply for revision and expect permit to be revalidated by "CAAC normal department" before 0800Z that day with no extra fee.

LANDING PERMITS 
• Air carriers from non-EEA (European Economic Area) member states operating individual 
commercial flights to Germany require a landing permit (entry permission) issued by the 
German CAA (LBA) 
• Private flights do not require a landing permit 
• Carriers from member states of the EEA that are allowed to exercise traffic rights on 
routes designated as intra-community air traffic in the EEA do not require a landing 
permit 
• Two full working days are needed to obtain the permit 
• Contact permit@germanaviation.com to obtain further information.

REQ FOR SAUDI ARABIA LND PMT REQ: 
-DEADLINE IS NOT LESS THAN 24HRS BEFORE FLIGHT 
-FULL FLIGHT DETAILS INCLUDING PAX,CREW 
-A/C DETAILS AND DOCUMENTS (NOISE,REGISTRATION,AIRWORTHINESS,INSURANCE,AOC)
-FULL FLIGHT SCHEDULE 
-LOCAL AGENT DETAILS IN SAUDI ARABIA 
-RECEIVING PARTY (EITHER PRIVATE PERSON OR COMPANY CONTACT PERSON NAME,ADDRESS AND TEL. NUMBER). MANDATORY UNLESS PURPOSE OF FLIGHT IS UMRAH,VISITING OF HOLY PLACES. 
-SHOULD BE SUBMITTED 72 HOURS BEFORE FLIGHT 

SAUDI ARABIA CAA IS VERY STRICT IN REGARDS OF CABOTAGE QUESTION. PLEASE REQUEST SAUDI ARABIA PERMISSION WITH CAUTION. 
PAX PICK-UP DURING DOMESTIC FLIGHTS IS PROHIBITED. 
PAX DROP-OFF DURING DOMESTIC FLIGHTS IS ALLOWED. 
PROVIDER NOTE: ONLY JETEX CAN ASSIST WITH CABOTAGE PERMIT.  JETEX ALSO CAN ASSIST TO OBTAIN LANDING PERMIT WITHOUT RECEIVING PARTY (IF FLIGHTS IS NOT DIPLOMATIC) 
-IT IS POSSIBLE TO REQUEST LANDING PERMISSION SEPARATELY FROM HANDING IN SAUDI ARABIA. 
-SAUDI ARABIA PERMIT VALID 24H FORWARD. ANY OTHER CASE - RE-VALIDATION REQUIRED.
